questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.

From (i), Ajay and Bijay can be selected as follows:
⇒ Both Ajay and Bijay are selected.
⇒ Only Bijay is selected.

From (ii), Chinmay and Eshwar can be selected as follows:  
⇒ Only Eshwar is selected.
⇒ Only Chinmay is selected.
⇒ Both Eshwar and Chinmay are selected.

(1) Chinmay, Ajay, Bijay
(2) Chinmay, Bijay, Deepak
If only Eshwar is selected, the possibilities are:
(3) Eshwar, Ajay, Bijay
(4) Eshwar, Bijay, Deepak
If both Chinmay and Eshwar are selected, the possibilities are:
(5) Chinmay, Eshwar, Deepak
(6) Chinmay, Eshwar, Bijay
